integrity: Analytic proof given; numerical verification illustrative only; no independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Closed SIR; iid susceptible risk-path distribution across individuals; stationary one-time susceptibility marginals; bounded exogenous susceptibility; homogeneous infectiousness and recovery. Does not cover behavioral feedback, contacts, or reinfection. Publication priority unresolved against all possible equivalent Feynman-Kac/general heterogeneous SIR inequalities.
title: A universal final-size sandwich for epidemics with fluctuating individual susceptibility
